title: 第25章 带大佬去新手村？
novel_title: 开局废灵根，成了宗门团宠小师叔
content_zh:
顾念念听懂了。

    原来她来这里是被人推着来的。

    她抬眼看向挡在自己面前的萧易水和星元。

    想起这些日子以来，他们陪着她的那些画面，又想到了老乞丐。

    果然这世上只有老乞丐对她才是最好的那个。

    他一直在告诉她，不要相信无缘无故的好，所有这类的好都是带着目的性的。

    可在这里，在胡三之后，她还是相信了这世上会有人只是为了疼她而存在。

    她以为萧易水是上天送来的，星元也是上天送来的，甚至连洛靳也是上天送来的。

    她心里高兴，夜里抱着被子都会傻乐呵。

    在这里，她终于还是被人疼着被人在乎着的。

    可是现在，这层窗户纸被捅破了。

    绯月尊者离开后，长老们也陆续跟着离开。

    只有大长老留了下来。

    这是他第二次见到顾念念，比起第一次，小姑娘现在看上去珠圆玉润，粉雕玉琢，很是可爱。

    眉宇间有着宗主的神韵，面容也有几分像那个人。

    他扶着长长的胡须，笑得十分和蔼。

    拿出一个储物袋递给了顾念念。

    “这是宗主让老夫给你的，明日的秘境让你多加小心。”

    顾念念脸上带着激动和感激。

    “谢谢。”

    然后，她像所有的孩童一样，问了一个问题。

    “长老，我要是从秘境回来可以去见仙人爹爹吗？”

    大长老心里轻叹一口气。

    这个孩子出生就被丢弃，因为那个人。

    如今被找回来，也是因为那个人。

    然后又被丢弃去了杂役院，发生了那样的事情。

    宗主虽然也维护，可他的维护仅仅是为了宗门，为了修真界，却从来不是为了眼前这个孩子。

    在宗主的心里，眼前这个小女娃，不是他的女儿。

    大长老又拿出一个玉瓶。

    “这里有几粒丹药，是老夫送你的，希望你能为宗门在秘境里多争光。”

    顾念念捧着那个玉瓶用力地点头。

    “我会的，争光就能证明我不是废物，就能见到仙人爹爹了，”

    大长老笑而不语。

    他转过眼看向萧易寒，从手里递过去一个令牌。

    “这是秘境令牌，明日你可以跟着她一起去秘境。至于如何进去，老夫知道你有办法。”

    天渊秘境止步于筑基。

    萧易寒手中盘玩着秘境令牌，眼含讥讽。
content_en:
Gu Niannian understood.

    It turns out that she was pushed here.

    She raised her eyes and looked at Xiao Yishui and Xingyuan who were standing in front of her.

    Thinking of the scenes of them accompanying her these days, she thought of the old beggar again.

    Sure enough, only the old beggar was the best to her in this world.

    He has been telling her not to believe in good things without a reason. All such good things have a purpose.

    But here, after Hu San, she still believed that there were people in this world who only existed to love her.

    She thought Xiao Yishui was sent from heaven, Xingyuan was also sent from heaven, and even Luo Jin was sent from heaven.

    She was so happy that she felt silly and happy hugging the quilt at night.

    Here, she was finally loved and cared about.

    But now, this layer of window paper has been pierced.

    After Lord Feiyue left, the elders also left one after another.

    Only the great elder remained.

    This was the second time he saw Gu Niannian. Compared with the first time, the little girl now looked rounder, pinker, and more adorable.

    There is the charm of the sect master between his eyebrows, and his face is somewhat like that person.

    He held his long beard and smiled very kindly.

    He took out a storage bag and handed it to Gu Niannian.

    "This is what the sect master asked me to give to you. You should be more careful in the secret realm tomorrow."

    Gu Niannian's face was filled with excitement and gratitude.

    "Thank you."

    Then, like all children, she asked a question.

    "Elder, if I come back from the secret realm, can I go see the immortal father?"

    The great elder sighed softly in his heart.

    This child was abandoned at birth because of that person.

    Now that he was found, it was also because of that person.

    Then he was thrown into the prison yard and something like that happened.

    Although the sect leader also defended, his defense was only for the sect and the world of cultivation, but never for the child in front of him.

    In the sect leader's heart, the little girl in front of him was not his daughter.

    The great elder took out another jade bottle.

    "Here are a few pills, which I gave to you. I hope you can bring more glory to the sect in the secret realm."

    Gu Niannian nodded vigorously while holding the jade bottle.

    "I will do it. If I gain glory, I will be able to prove that I am not a waste, and I will be able to meet the immortal father."

    The great elder smiled and said nothing.

    He turned to look at Xiao Yihan and handed over a token from his hand.

    "This is the secret realm token. You can follow her to the secret realm tomorrow. As for how to get in, I know you have a way."

    Tianyuan Secret Realm stops at foundation building.

    Xiao Yihan played with the secret realm token in his hand with sarcasm in his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 25 Taking the boss to Novice Village?
